question: Q, W, E, R, T and Y live on seven different floors in the same building, in which one floor is vacant. The lowest floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7. T lives on the 7th floor, and W lives on the 1st floor. Only Y lives between R and W, and none of the floors between R and W is vacant. E lives on the 5th floor. Only Q lives between T and E. Which floor is vacant?
solution:
Given:

Q, W, E, R, T and Y live on 7 different floors in the same building, in which one floor is vacant. The lowest floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7.

T lives on the 7th floor, and W lives on the 1st floor

Only Y lives between R and W, and none of the floors between R and W is vacant

E lives on the 5th floor.

Only Q lives between T and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2df97f30d9e59869baf9db1d5a115cf06b1fd0acaad5d52b877392c6668e4139.png] 

So, 4th floor is vacant.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
